sentences.text: Sazavis was an enantiornithine bird that lived during the Late Cretaceous period.
This creature measured about 18.5 centimeters in length, making it roughly the size of a pigeon.
The only known fossil is a single tibiotarsus bone approximately 4.5 millimeters wide at its distal joint.
The fossil remains of Sazavis were discovered in the Bissekty Formation.
Only one species of Sazavis is currently known to science, named Sazavis prisca.
Sazavis belongs to the parent group Alexornithidae.
It lived during the Turonian stage, between 93.9 and 89.8 million years ago.
Sazavis likely lived in the region now known as the Kyzyl Kum desert in Uzbekistan.
It likely inhabited coastal areas or liman forests dominated by flowering plants from the Platanaceae family.
